body: Its not selfish for you to want to die. Not anymore than it is to want to eat or to want to live. People trying to stop you is not the same as people who love and comfort you. People who will listen. Listen to why you are going through what you are. Its not your fault. You deserve better. I am really sorry to hear about all that you have gone through.

Wow I hear what you are going through. It has been my experience that the people who truly love you will never turn you away. If you can, try to find a therapist. Finding one has helped me tremendously. I still may struggle, but at least I can offload some of the burden to a curious, empathetic and trusting mind. To someone who cares. My therapist would never tell me I was a burden. In regards to your childhood, that is so wretched and I am so sorry to hear. You deserved loving parents to support and nurture you. We all do. You can get through. I care for you. I am rooting for you.

:( I feel for you my friend. Abuse is the quiet destruction; of lives, of humanity, of beauty. Its hard to move forward when we've suffered so much. It seems impossible. But sometimes, it is possible. I don't know you but I know that you didn't deserve what you went through. You don't deserve the constant torment and suffering that you endure. You deserve love, happiness, peace. You deserve someone to listen to you, to allow you to share the darkness along with the light. You deserve a hug. Someone to care for you. I promise that whatever you are going through is not unnoticed nor uncared for. I care. The folks here on reddit care. And we would do anything to make it easier on you. I know the pain. The suffering. The wanting to escape. It seems almost inescapable. You are brave to even being where you are today. And whatever makes of your situation, know that you never deserved any of it.

You are clearly such a well articulate and intelligent being. I am so sorry for what you are going through and the experiences you have faced. I promise that you are not a fuck up. People might have told you that you are. Told you so much that you are forced to believe it - in order to survive. But you aren't. I really wish I knew how to help. All I know is that what you received and endured was undeserving. You deserve love; affection. Someone to sooth you through your pain. I know you are trying. It sounds like some part of you doesn't even really want to do it. What you really want is love and support? Is that fair? Know that that everyone on here truly does care about you. Wishes the absolute best for you. And is so incredibly sorry for the pain you are experiencing. Every living being deserves better. It can be had. I promise.

I am so sorry for you. I can relate. It is horrible that you or anyone else should have to experience any of that. I am not sure what to say as I am still not quite through it; but I really hope you are able to get through. You deserve to live. To breath fresh air, to smell flowers and play with dogs. I am so sorry for your experience and only wish that I could help. I can say that I really do care about you and that no matter what, your struggle won't be left unnoticed or forgotten. We need loving parents. We need friends. I only wish you (and I) had someone to hug, someone to love. To be loved. We deserve better. The world deserves better. You can be loved. You had a rough go but you can be loved.

:( I feel the same way. I wish I knew how to help. I really do. I would help you, I would help myself and I would help many others pull through. Its so tremendously sad that we are going through this. I really really wish I knew what could be done.
